name: LocusQ 2.4 Physics DAW Freeze
description: Phase 2.4 acceptance proxy: when phys_frozen_0=1.0, phys_out_gain_mod_0 must hold its snapshot value and must not track live physics changes. When phys_frozen_0=0.0 (LIVE), phys_out_gain_mod_0 must follow the attractor-driven gain modulation. Verifies the LIVE/FROZEN gate and APVTS parameter mirror contract defined in parameter-spec.md.

scene_setup.description: Single physics-enabled emitter near an active attractor. Attractor proximity drives non-zero phys_out_gain_mod_0. At t=1s phys_frozen_0 is set to 1.0 (FROZEN); phys_out_gain_mod_0 must hold the snapshot value for the remainder of the window.

live_window.description: LIVE phase — attractor drives gain modulation

frozen_window.description: FROZEN phase — gain mod must be constant (snapshot held)

gain_mod_live_nonzero.description: In LIVE phase, attractor proximity should drive nonzero gain mod variance

gain_mod_frozen_constant.description: In FROZEN phase, gain mod must not change — snapshot must be held

pass_criteria: All hard_fail invariants must pass. gain_mod_live_nonzero is warn-only (depends on attractor convergence timing).
